create_gtn_graph: create a gtn Graph object with a specified start node for building finite state transducers
add_node_to_graph: add a node to the graph with optional start and end flags to define states
add_arc_to_graph: add an arc between two nodes with a symbol label to define transitions in the graph
draw_graph_to_pdf: draw and export a gtn graph to a PDF file with symbol labels for visualization
union_graphs: union multiple gtn graphs into a single graph that recognizes the combined language of all inputs
